# IGNIS SAFE — BFP Dasmariñas City Fire Station

IGNIS SAFE is the public information and secure personnel portal for the Bureau of Fire Protection Dasmariñas City Fire Station.

## Public pages

- [IGNIS SAFE home](https://bfp-dasmacfs.com/): Fire safety services, public advisories, and station contact information.
- [Organizational chart](https://bfp-dasmacfs.com/organizational-chart): Station leadership and reporting structure.
- [Send a message](https://bfp-dasmacfs.com/send-message): Contact the station about fire safety inspection, permits, and advisories.
- [Terms of use](https://bfp-dasmacfs.com/terms): Portal terms of use.
- [Privacy policy](https://bfp-dasmacfs.com/privacy): Portal privacy policy.

## Secure portal

- [Sign in](https://bfp-dasmacfs.com/login): Authorized administrator and personnel sign-in.
- [Personnel workspace](https://bfp-dasmacfs.com/personnel/operations): Authorized personnel shift schedule and leave-request workspace.
